title: Algerian Grape Pancakes
description: A sweet and savory Algerian-inspired pancake dish, perfect for breakfast or brunch. The addition of grape syrup adds a unique twist to traditional pancakes.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, yeast, and 1 cup of warm water.
Let the mixture sit for 10-15 minutes, or until the yeast is activated and foamy.
Add the pureed grape, chopped olives, and chopped leaves to the bowl. Mix until well combined.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, or until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes warm with additional grape syrup if desired.
